reason: I'd probably download it for the free 14 days since there's no auto-payment, but I wouldn't pay. My bedtime moves every week, so I doubt the app can learn when to turn off, and the free version with 30/60-minute timers is close enough to what I already do with YouTube sleep sounds.
objection: The 'fewer minutes to fall asleep' number comes from my own 10-second morning guess, not from any real measurement, so it looks like proof but isn't. I can't see any reviews or app-store ratings yet, and the automatic resume needs an armband that won't come until 2028.
would_change_my_mind: If on day 14 my record showed I was falling asleep clearly faster, around 10 minutes or more, and the app had solid 4-star-plus reviews from people with irregular schedules like mine.
